verification.passCondition: The approved Phase A contract, 32 survivors, feedback trail, workbench and deterministic package continue to pass.

The canonical Phase B 1.0.0 system validates, preserves all 32 Phase A inputs, records the complete Round 03 and unanimous Round 04 feedback, omits B-FT04, B-FT06 and the separate inheritance gallery, renders the exact 46 surviving functional specimen IDs across six families and rebuilds deterministically with bounded production authority true.
Product identity comes only from the registry; Offer, Price, Plan, Bundle, LineItem, ProofRecord and Checkout remain fixture or consumer data with no payment-provider logic.

Every approved functional specimen remains attributable to approved Phase A sources, every required component and pattern has at least one materially distinct Round 04 specimen, and the unanimous approval record remains intact.
Every bento cell declares a product, proof, workflow, metric, media, integration, quote or action job; decorative filler and multiple live cells are rejected.
Each component proves only applicable interaction, choice, availability, async and commerce states, including purchase processing and recovery where owned.

The approval workbench proves representative compact and expanded compositions, preserves source order and documents the exhaustive 240–1160px container and 320–1440px viewport matrix as required follow-up under EXP-08 and consumer proof.

Semantic elements, focus contracts, reduced motion and truthful non-color status are present; exhaustive keyboard-only, async-announcement, touch-target and 200% zoom proof remains a named EXP-08 and consumer-proof obligation.

At most one focal Deep Mineral plate animates automatically; repeated products and all pricing, checkout, menu, footer and mobile-summary contexts remain exact static twins. A focused bundle stack may cycle static-card emphasis without moving Wings, type or geometry and without allocating another Living Core.
The six discovery, one-time, SaaS, bundle, waitlist and mobile journeys remain coherent from entry through confirmation or safe recovery.
Olli approves the complete functional website component system without reopening the Phase A visual grammar.

humanGate.approvalQuestion: Do the Phase B components, website patterns and complete journeys turn the approved Round 10 grammar into a coherent, responsive, accessible and commercially honest functional website system?
